_meta.method: Gmail receipt forensics (amounts extracted from receipt bodies) + web pricing (cited). Estimated values flagged explicitly.

anthropic_claude_max.type: subscription (consumer/Pro UI + Claude Code via MAX OAuth)
anthropic_claude_max.detail: UPGRADED from Max 5x ($100) to Max 20x ($200) on 2026-05-23. May receipt = $168.54 net (prorated, $200.00 Max 20x minus $31.46 credit for unused 5x). Steady-state = $200.00/mo. History: Feb 21 Claude Pro $20 -> Mar/Apr/early-May Max 5x $100 -> May 23 Max 20x $200.
anthropic_claude_max.no_separate_charges_found: No separate Console/API charge in any Anthropic receipt. The Feb 21 'Claude Pro $20' was REPLACED by Max, not stacked. Only ONE active Anthropic line: $200 Max 20x.
anthropic_claude_max.recommendation_hint: KEEP — foundation. Orchestrator runs on this at $0 marginal (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY popped).

google_ai_pro.type: consumer subscription (Google One / Gemini app + 5TB) — NO API access
google_ai_pro.detail: Google AI Pro (5 TB) (Google One) $19.99/mo + $0.61 tax = $20.60. Auto-renews the 5th monthly (receipts Apr 5, May 5, Jun 5). Consumer UI only; cannot be called from the autonomous stack (per GOOGLE_AI_PRO_INTEGRATION_SPSA).
google_ai_pro.recommendation_hint: KEEP if app surfaces (NotebookLM/Deep Research/Gemini-in-Gmail) are actually used; otherwise CUT — it buys nothing the scripts can call.

google_cloud_gemini_api.detail: Separate from the $20 AI Pro consumer sub. Normal months ~$4-5. April spiked to $100 + $53 (one-time experimentation, two payments). Budget alert cap set at $10/mo. This is the bill that grows if the stack leans on Gemini API.
google_cloud_gemini_api.recommendation_hint: WATCH — keep budget cap at $10/mo; this is the real variable cost of a Gemini fallback layer.

redundancy_analysis.poe_vs_claude_max: REDUNDANT. Poe's whole value prop is multi-model UI access. Claude MAX 20x ($200) + Google AI Pro app (Gemini) already give frontier-model coverage. Poe $4.99 (and any future points) is duplicative.
redundancy_analysis.openai_plus: N/A — not subscribed (good; ChatGPT Plus would duplicate MAX/Poe).
redundancy_analysis.perplexity_pro_vs_credits: Commander correctly bought METERED $10 credits, NOT the $20 Pro sub. Pro's $5/mo bundled API credit (web-reported as possibly removed in 2026) would not justify $20/mo for API-driven use. Stay metered.
redundancy_analysis.google_ai_pro_app_vs_api: Not redundant with each other but the $20 consumer sub adds ZERO programmatic capability — only worth it if the human-facing app surfaces (NotebookLM/Deep Research/Gemini-in-Gmail) are genuinely used.

part_b_pricing_web.note: Gemini API + Google AI Pro pricing already in GOOGLE_AI_PRO_INTEGRATION_SPSA_2026-06-15.md — not duplicated here.

perplexity_pro_20.includes: unlimited Pro Search + 20 Deep Research/day + (historically) $5/mo Sonar API credits — credit reportedly removed ~Mar 2026, status in flux
perplexity_pro_20.consumer_vs_api_trap: Pro is a CONSUMER subscription; its bundled API credit (if present) is only $5/mo and does not roll over. For API-driven use, metered credits beat the $20 sub.
